summary: Verified the FullScreenNote in-place editor. All 9 review scenarios pass on the preview URL (/apps/iron-rabbit-notes/launch): title is an editable input, content is an editable textarea, typing updates visible text immediately, save-status pill transitions Editing… → Saved within ~900ms (debounce 700ms), footer 'Edited:' timestamp updates, edits persist to IndexedDB across close/reopen, the old fullscreen-edit-btn is gone, delete + close buttons still work, save-on-close flush logic is present in handleClose.

issues: Radix a11y warning still present in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' (non-blocking; carried from iterations 4/5).

passed_tests: Fullscreen opens for a note (data-testid='fullscreen-note') with pre-populated title/content matching the note.
Title input (data-testid='fullscreen-title-input') is editable and reflects typing immediately.
Content textarea (data-testid='fullscreen-content-input') is editable and reflects typing immediately.

Save-status (data-testid='fullscreen-save-status') shows 'Editing…' right after keystroke and transitions to 'Saved' within ~900ms — debounced 700ms auto-save confirmed on BOTH title edits and content edits.
After auto-save, footer text contains 'Edited: <timestamp>' — proving updated_at is written on save.

PERSISTENCE PROOF #1 (first run): Created note edited to 'TEST_Inline_924466', closed full-screen, and found the SAME edited title rendered in the accordion list — the notes list re-fetches from IndexedDB via fetchData, so the fresh title appearing there proves the auto-save wrote to StorageService (IndexedDB).

PERSISTENCE PROOF #2 (second run): Created + edited note to 'TEST_Edited_463552', closed full-screen, accordion list showed 'TEST_Edited_463552' at the top — again confirming IndexedDB save via StorageService.saveNote.

PERSISTENCE PROOF #3 (first run reopen): Reopened full-screen for a previously-edited note and both the title input value AND content textarea value matched the previous edits (assertions on reopened_title == new_title and reopened_content == new_content both passed).
The OLD data-testid='fullscreen-edit-btn' no longer exists in the DOM (count=0) — editing is fully inline now.
Delete button (data-testid='fullscreen-delete-btn') closes the full-screen and removes the note from the list.
Close button (data-testid='fullscreen-close-btn') closes the full-screen view.

Save-on-close flush code path exists in FullScreenNote.handleClose (NotesApp.jsx L182-190): if `dirty`, awaits onSaveInline before invoking onClose — flushes pending edits when user closes within the 700ms debounce window.
Backdrop click also invokes handleClose (line 196: onClick={handleClose}), so the flush logic is applied to backdrop-close as well.
5 accordion notes visible after tests; no console errors during editing; only the pre-existing Radix a11y warning shown.
action_items: (Optional / minor) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to Edit Note / Settings DialogContent to silence the Radix a11y console warning (carried over from prior iterations).
critical_code_review_comments: FullScreenNote (NotesApp.jsx L140-246) is a clean in-place editor: local state (title, content, dirty, saving, savedAt), useEffect at L149 correctly resets local state on note-id change or when non-dirty upstream update arrives (updated_at guard prevents stomping user's in-flight edits).
Debounced auto-save useEffect at L161-172 uses a 700ms setTimeout that cancels on rerender (return () => clearTimeout(t)) — standard, correct debouncing pattern.
handleClose at L182 flushes pending edits before calling onClose — good UX for save-on-close.
handleSaveInline in NotesApp (L871-888) is silent (no toast, matching the 'silent auto-save' UX), correctly refreshes notes+categories after save so accordion list stays in sync.
sync-effect at L726-735 still keeps fullScreenNote in sync with the fresh notes array (needed because handleSaveInline updates notes state — the effect diffs by updated_at). Good.
Save-status pill uses aria-live='polite' — good a11y for screen readers.

Minor: the debounced auto-save effect deps only include [title, content, dirty]; if the note id changes while dirty=true, the useEffect at L149 skips reset (guarded by !dirty), which is intentional to protect unsaved edits — but this means switching notes while dirty could lead to saving edits to the previously-viewed note under the new note's id after the id-ref updates. In practice this can't happen because the full-screen shows one note at a time (opening a new note first closes the current), so this is a theoretical edge only.
No changes to existing edit-modal flow — that still works from the accordion 'Edit' icon.
seed_data_creation: Two test notes created during testing: 'TEST_Inline_924466' (first run, edited via inline editor and verified persisted), and 'TEST_Init_463552' → 'TEST_Edited_463552' (second run). The second test's delete step did not run due to a Playwright selector timing race, so the TEST_Edited_463552 note may still exist in the browser's IndexedDB in the automation container context (not user's browser). No impact on user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The full-screen note is now a live in-place editor. Selectors: [data-testid='fullscreen-note'], [data-testid='fullscreen-title-input'] (input element), [data-testid='fullscreen-content-input'] (textarea), [data-testid='fullscreen-save-status'] (Editing…/Saving…/Saved pill), [data-testid='fullscreen-close-btn'], [data-testid='fullscreen-delete-btn'], [data-testid='fullscreen-share-btn']. IMPORTANT: [data-testid='fullscreen-edit-btn'] NO LONGER EXISTS — editing is inline. Auto-save debounce is 700ms; wait ~900-2000ms after last keystroke before asserting 'Saved'. To verify persistence, look for the edited title in the accordion list AFTER closing the full-screen (the list refreshes from IndexedDB, so its presence there = save confirmed). Radix Collapsible reopen after fullscreen close can be racy — use longer waits (500-800ms) between accordion trigger click and full-screen click.
rca of the issue: User's iteration-5 fix only stopped the full-screen from collapsing when clicking the edit icon (the editing itself was still done in a separate modal). User asked for direct in-place editing inside the full-screen. Fix applied by main agent: converted FullScreenNote (NotesApp.jsx L140-246) from a read-only viewer into an editor — added local title/content state, a dirty flag, a 700ms-debounced useEffect that calls onSaveInline, a save-status indicator (Editing…/Saving…/Saved), and a save-on-close flush in handleClose. Rendered an <input> for title and a <textarea> for content directly in the full-screen. Removed the old edit-icon button and the onEdit prop. Handler handleSaveInline (NotesApp.jsx L871) persists silently to StorageService (IndexedDB) and re-syncs the notes list. Verified end-to-end: type in fullscreen → status flips Editing→Saved → close → accordion list re-fetches from IndexedDB and shows the new title → reopen → both inputs pre-populated with saved values.
